<!-- @type: ability | @subtype: signature | @id: pounce -->
### Pounce

*The panther bunches up, then uncoils into a deadly leap.*

| **Companion, Melee, Weapon** |     **Maneuver** |
|------------------------------|-----------------:|
| **📏 Melee 1**               | **🎯 One enemy** |

**Effect:** The target takes damage equal to 3 + the panther's Might score.

<!-- @type: feature | @id: mighty-spring -->
### Mighty Spring

Whenever the panther takes the Advance move action, they can jump.

<!-- @type: featureblock -->
### Panther Advancement Features

<!-- @type: feature | @id: cat-and-mouse | @level: 3 -->
#### Cat and Mouse

Whenever the panther makes a strike while rampaging, it can knock the target prone.
